subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose this yield-only runtime control through the public Plugin SDK?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but adding a public plugin result field and host control seam is a compatibility and ownership decision that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the narrow API
options.body: Accept the yield-only result control, document its guarantees and distinction from `terminate`, and let exact-head checks gate landing.

options.title: Keep control internal
options.body: Remove the public helper and result field while retaining any useful host-internal orchestration work for a later API design.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Defer this PR until the structured-interaction work defines a generalized plugin-to-runtime control contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API
recommendation.body: Accept the yield-only result control, document its guarantees and distinction from `terminate`, and let exact-head checks gate landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from recent embedded-agent and session-tool history.
